meta.title: Session Manager
meta.description: Adds a Session Manager page to Settings: browse sessions per workspace (title, time, size), delete single or many sessions at once, bulk-clean sessions older than 30/15/7 days, delete an entire workspace, and open the session storage directory. Deletion is REAL: it removes the session log files (session.v4.jsonl.zstd etc.) plus registry records, unlike the built-in "archive".
